matches.rationale: GT1 concerns Equation (11)'s asymmetric fusion formula with ratio terms that can produce negative weights, conflicting with the claim of positive weights summing to 1. Pred_1 addresses a different issue: that the adaptive weights λ_v^t and λ_c^t defined in Eq. (10) do not sum to 1 because they exclude query-token attention mass. These are distinct mathematical defects in different equations (11 vs. 10) with different mechanisms.

GT2 concerns the attention reallocation formulas (Eq. 5) failing to preserve causal masking constraints during autoregressive decoding. Pred_1 addresses the logits fusion weights in Section 4.2 and their failure to sum to 1, which is unrelated to causal masking or attention reallocation. No finding detects the causal mask preservation issue.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Identifies a genuine mathematical error (weights not summing to 1 due to excluded query attention) that is not among the ground-truth defects.
